findings.reason: the author must either name the node that runs `imas-alambic write 101154 101031 --out <ids_root>` and confirm it is dispatched, or drop the run-file dependency and read the per-IDS layout the pulses actually have on disk.
findings.text: §3 says "The run files 101154_0.nc and 101031_0.nc are written by jt60sa-facility-mint's coordinator under §8's done-when, and this section's node dispatches once both exist", but §8 (merge 106c1104) landed the writer `write_pulse`/`pulse_path` (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/pulse_writer.py:292,303) without writing either pulse, and no `*_0.nc` exists on disk; the precondition names a mechanism whose owner is now landed but whose producing node is unassigned, so the section can wait forever on an event nobody is scheduled to raise

findings.reason: taking the (IDS, path) series as an argument now costs nothing and is the difference between §2 reusing this path and forking it.
findings.text: the function's interface is "takes the pulse and returns its figure" with the signal set hardcoded to coil currents and ip, yet §2 of this same plan (:71) reads `extract_signal_traces(magnetics, "flux_loop/flux")` and the probe field "the same way §1 draws the coil currents", so the signature fixed here cannot serve the next use and §2 must widen it or add a second function — two implementations of one open→extract→figure path

findings.reason: a builder retiring the actual constants still lands the refactor; the stale name is a documentation defect, not a design one, and correcting the sentence does not change the work.
findings.text: §3's account of the code it extends lists a module constant `PULSE_DIR` ("`SHOT`, `FIGURE`, `PULSE_DIR`"), but scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py defines no such symbol; the E101154-fixed constants are `SHOT` (:32), `FIGURE` (:34) and `PULSE_FILE` (:35)

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — the function is defined as "takes the pulse and returns its figure" but fixes the signal set to `pf_active "coil/current"` + `magnetics "ip"`, an interface too narrow for the reuse §2 already names.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §3 gates its dispatch on two run files that no landed or assigned node produces, and names no owner for the mechanism that writes them.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §3 adds one script-local function and retires `SHOT`/`FIGURE`/`PULSE_FILE` (scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:32-35), adding nothing to any of the four families, so it has no surface to retire or justify.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §3 cites and extends the existing machinery (`extract_signal_traces` imas_ink/extract.py:815, `time_trace_figure_mpl`, `render_to_bytes`, and the `pulse_path`/`resolve_settings` owners at pulse_writer.py:292 / settings.py:191) and refactors the existing `scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:_main` rather than proposing a parallel path.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the function replaces the body of `_main` (scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:45-55) and retires its constants; it is the existing entry point parameterised, not a new layer over it.
